text:
sam: Quick Q — who's bringing desk lights for the 'Desk Glow' challenge? :bulb:
tess: I'll throw mine in. Also mini prize for best photo? :sparkles:
lia: Count me in. Voting via reactions like :star: = winner, :heart: = people's choice?
noah: I'll bring a battery pack and some chocolate cookies for folks on site. :cookie:
sam: Also proposing a tiny virtual greeting card — anyone want to add doodles? https://tiny.redwood/holiday-card (feel free to drop a sticker)
desk-bot: Reminder: Desk Glow drop-off 16:00 local HQ. Upload photos to #random.
tess: Also can we have a 'cozy mug' selfie subcategory? :mug: I'll post mine.
lia: Yup posting at ~15:55 with fairy lights. not shown here. :)
noah: I'll swing by at 15:40 to stash snacks & lights. if someone is at HQ earlier LMK and i'll hide a little santa cookie.
sam: Logistics checklist pinned: 1) lights 2) photos in #random 3) reactions voting 4) small prize (candies)
tess: Quick poll: /poll "Which day for Desk Glow?" "Thu 16:00" "Fri 16:00" "Either"
desk-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Thu 16:00.
sam: Sweet, see you Thursday. Also shoutout to facilities for spare extension cords :raised_hands:
lia: Happy almost-holidays y'all! :tada: Excited for the tiny chaos.
noah: Same here, can't wait to see everyone's setup :sparkles:
desk-bot: Event ended: photos received 9. Winners by reactions: best lights = tess, best mug selfie = lia, people's choice = noah. Congrats! :trophy:
